bytes_rounding: every byte total is rounded to the nearest 100 KB; tier totals cover published parts only (tier_bytes_rule)

ledger.dropbox_name_hit_rule: a MISSING-proof row counts as having a Dropbox name hit when main#594 recorded a STRONG or WEAK hit for it at row level (30 rows) or in its aggregated ledger_hits (18 rows); 48 rows in all, 83 without
ledger.note: the name rule is byte-for-byte the rule of main#594 (STRONG stem equality; WEAK adjacent tokens, a consecutive pair, or one rare token in the title stem); Drive titles are prose, so lone-token hits are labelled WEAK_LONE and should be read as the weakest class; the no_dropbox_name_hit flag is computed for MISSING-proof rows only

liveness.listing: connector search of items modified after 2026-09-17T00:00Z in ten windows; metadata only

row_level_rule: per-file lines only where the title is already on main (DRV-H2/DRV-H3 maps) or the bytes are already public (GIT_EXACT, ARCHIVE_EXACT); digests only for public bytes; every other file is counted only, in DRIVE_AGGREGATE.tsv by hub x tier x class over those files alone, where classes below 3 files are merged into (other) per hub and tier and a cell still below 3 files prints its count and no bytes; the same rule for carriers and for ledger hits; 03_PERSONAL items counted only
snapshot: drive/inventory.jsonl, drive/source_map/Archive_Members.csv and drive/deltas/2026-09-18..20 in the drive/ tree at a01c72f1 (Drive-GitHub hardening branch); the 2026-09-17 accessibility publication
tier_bytes_rule: a tier byte total covers only the parts that print bytes elsewhere in this directory (rows with public bytes, and aggregate cells of three files or more); files in count-only cells and title-public rows without public bytes are excluded, so no withheld size can be recovered by differencing (skeptic verdict on P-3)
